name: Thai Lemonade
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cm piece of ginger, peeled and cut into pieces

steps: Bring the water to a boil with the sugar, lemon grass, and ginger. Boil for 20 minutes.
Allow the syrup to cool, then remove lemongrass and ginger.
Pour the syrup in 4 large glasses, and add the carbonated water.
